{"items": [
{"type": "obligation", "text": "LEA leadership teams are encouraged to use it to surface strengths, identify gaps, and prioritize near-term action steps aligned to Maryland's critical elements for safe, informed, and equitable AI integration.", "force": "recommendation", "binds": "LEA leadership teams", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Before developing or revising local AI policies and practices, leadership teams should assess their current stage of implementation across Maryland's critical elements.", "force": "recommendation", "binds": "leadership teams", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "As a leadership team, review each critical element below and determine your current stage of implementation.", "force": "recommendation", "binds": "leadership team", "responsible_party_stated": true, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Document the rationale for each rating.", "force": "recommendation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Include examples of existing initiatives, policies, pilot programs, or operational uses that informed your assessment.", "force": "recommendation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Identify one or two immediate next steps for each area.", "force": "recommendation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "obligation", "text": "Use your responses to prioritize deeper planning and coordinated action.", "force": "recommendation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Exploring", "text": "Exploring. The LEA is developing awareness of AI's implications. Conversations are emerging, but formal structures, policies, or coordinated plans are not yet established."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Organizing", "text": "Organizing. Cross-functional discussions have begun. Initial guidance, pilot efforts, or leadership teams may exist, but shared definitions, expectations, and implementation structures are still developing."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Piloting", "text": "Piloting. AI tools or instructional approaches are being tested in defined contexts. Policies and professional learning are emerging, and feedback mechanisms are beginning to form."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Scaling", "text": "Scaling. AI integration is expanding across departments or schools. Governance structures, professional learning systems, and monitoring practices are aligned and coordinated."},
{"type": "definition", "term": "Sustaining and Adapting", "text": "Sustaining and Adapting. AI integration is embedded within instructional and operational systems. Continuous improvement cycles, community engagement, and policy review processes are established and responsive to change."},
{"type": "reference", "text": "Maryland K-12 AI Guidance", "cited_instrument": "Maryland K-12 AI Guidance"}
]}

{"type": "obligation", "text": "Engage students and families in structured dialogue about AI risks and representation.", "force": "recommendation", "binds": null, "responsible_party_stated": false, "mechanism_stated": null}
]}
